newsitem.title: USA: Gannett Co USA TODAY ad revenues up 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gannett Co USA TODAY ad revenues up 9 pct.

text.p: Gannett Co said on Monday that USA TODAY advertising revenue grew 9 percent as the company's newspaper operating net income rose 41.0 percent from the same quarter a year ago.

Gannett said stronger advertising demand, lower newsprint costs, strong results at USA TODAY and improvement at the Detroit News helped its newspaper segment increase operating net income to $207.2 million, from $147.0 million a year ago.
Overall ad revenue rose 7 percent, and the Detroit News, which was hurt by a strike, had a profit for the first quarter of 1997, the company said.
The company's broadcasting operating net income was up 14.7 percent, to $57.4 million to $50.0 million.
